## ICdcFilter type

Subscribe filter — a sub-DB name, or name plus operation.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ICdcFilter = string | {
    db: string;
    op?: `put` | `delete` | `clear`;
};
```

## Remarks

A plain string listens to all write kinds on that sub-DB; the object form narrows delivery to one `op`<!-- -->.
